rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person who looks healthy, vigorous, and full of life.

example.english: Why do you look so blooming lately?
example.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 me1 gam3 saang1 maang5 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a visibly radiant, healthy, youthful-looking appearance, especially in more polished speech or writing.

example.english: After a few days’ rest, they looked blooming.
example.traditional: 休息咗幾日之後，佢顯得容光煥發。
example.jyutping: jau1 sik1 zo2 gei2 jat6 zi1 hau6 keoi5 hin2 dak1 jung4 gwong1 wun6 faat3
